ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, April 18, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to French Commercial, Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design students on Monday, April 25, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website. BADM 380 is offered online in the summer and winter terms. No exceptions will be made. There are currently 10 seats reserved for Gies College of Business international exchange students only (any exchange students outside of GCOB who try to register will be removed); any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 26, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
